source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_systemHealth" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i health (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the system health OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_systemHealth SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes an automatable read after setup but changes SNMPv3 to v2c, guesses a generic Net-SNMP example subtree and filters away typed context.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; correctly rejects the guessed OID/security mode and requires semantic health values, but treats obtainable vendor MIB/OID/enum inputs as irreducible.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 750/2291 remains PARTIAL while repeating the v2c/generic-OID shortcut.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION result is non-counting history; the classification was independently confirmed under ED-34 and ED-36.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 allows a Project Override client while preserving the original IReasoning method and coverage difference; ED-36 treats MIB/OID/expected values as readiness inputs; ED-38 keeps the verdict engineer-owned.

original_test_intent: Retrieve the platform-defined BMC system-health objects over SNMPv3 and validate their typed semantic state, instance mapping and consistency with an independent BMC health source.
original_method: An engineer enables an SNMPv3 account in WebUI and uses IReasoning MIB Browser Get Next/Get Subtree on an undefined `$target`; Criteria separately require Net-SNMP retrieval of the same undefined target.
manual_activity: An engineer must configure and document the BMC SNMPv3 account/WebUI state and approve the canonical health object mapping. The agent can then run bounded queries, decode typed values and compare them with the expected health baseline.
required_inputs: vendor MIB module/version and exact health-summary plus contributing object OIDs
enumeration/severity meanings and expected healthy/degraded/fault values
SNMPv3 user/security level/authentication/privacy algorithms via protected secret injection
isolated manager ACL and time baseline
approved client equivalence and cleanup policy
safety_requirements: Do not enable SNMPv3 or create/change the BMC user until the account, ACL and restore policy are approved.
Never expose authentication/privacy secrets or usernames where policy treats them as sensitive.
Do not use v2c, the generic `.1.3.6.1.4.1.8072...` example or grep-only output as vendor system-health evidence.
Bound GETNEXT/WALK to approved objects and preserve types, indexes and errors; stop on unauthorized objects or unexpected write behavior.
Do not label successful retrieval as healthy without enum/baseline comparison; restore configuration and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer setup, resolve the approved MIB, run exact SNMPv3 GET/GETNEXT/WALK against the bounded health objects and preserve full typed output.
Map instances and enum/severity values, correlate with the independent health source and report discrepancies.
Do not operate WebUI, change accounts, claim IReasoning coverage when only Net-SNMP ran or set the final verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply/approve the MIB, exact health objects, instance and value semantics and expected baseline.
Configure and later restore the SNMPv3 account/WebUI state and approve IReasoning versus Net-SNMP coverage equivalence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command uses the wrong security mode, a Net-SNMP demonstration OID unrelated to the identified vendor health object and lossy `grep`; it cannot prove the source's SNMPv3 system-health semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-MIB-resolved, engineer-approved SNMPv3 health summary and contributing OIDs with a bounded exact query and full typed output; treat IReasoning and Net-SNMP as separate methods unless equivalence is approved.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, SNMPv3 WebUI/account setup, undefined `$target`, Net-SNMP Criteria and 10/5-minute values remain preserved source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind every health object to its MIB revision, numeric OID, type, index and enum meaning; query with protected SNMPv3, compare the summary and contributing objects with Project SPEC and an independent BMC health view, then restore setup.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified BMC firmware and matching vendor MIB release.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, MIB module, manager, IReasoning/Net-SNMP and security algorithm versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor SNMPv3/MIB and system-health semantic documentation plus Project health baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds canonical objects, typed expectations, independent correlation and tool-equivalence accounting without replacing the original IReasoning requirement.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Net-SNMP can provide equivalent protocol/object evidence when approved, but cannot claim the original GUI-client interaction; transport success alone does not prove healthy status.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: MIB/OIDs/types/enums/instances, expected baseline and client decision.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Aggregate health can lag component faults or hide the contributing sensor, so both summary and supporting objects should be retained.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may approve Net-SNMP instead of IReasoning only after recording original/actual tool, reason, object-level equivalence and any unverified GUI-client coverage. It may require both clients as separate checkpoints.
expected_evidence: redacted SNMPv3 WebUI/account/ACL configuration and cleanup artifacts
vendor MIB identity with numeric OID/type/index/enum mapping
complete bounded SNMPv3 typed output for health summary and contributing objects
exact baseline comparison and independent Redfish/IPMI/WebUI health correlation
tool-equivalence statement, errors/authorization evidence, BMC health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure explicitly requires IReasoning/SNMPv3 while Criteria switches to Net-SNMP, `$target` is unresolved in both, and DeepSeek changes security to v2c plus an unrelated generic OID. The test purpose remains identifiable despite these method/input conflicts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor MIB objects, enum meanings, expected baseline and approved client are Project readiness inputs for a clearly named system-health read. Once supplied, the hybrid setup and automated query can execute safely, so permanent BLOCKED would be inappropriate.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains PARTIAL/hybrid execution but rejects its v2c, generic OID and grep evidence and requires exact typed SNMPv3 semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION because the missing MIB/OID/value contract is obtainable readiness input under ED-36, not an unknowable purpose.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms the classification while strengthening client-equivalence and semantic-health evidence.

review_improvement: Turns an undefined `$target` into a future component-bound evidence contract without guessing it, and preserves the difference between protocol transport, semantic health and client-tool coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A successful walk proves only reachability unless exact vendor objects, types and enum meanings are compared. Those artifacts are not safely guessable, but their absence does not make the system-health purpose ambiguous; they are Project inputs. Manual SNMPv3 setup plus an automatable bounded query therefore fits REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, with tool substitution explicitly accounted for.
